title: Sherpa Tensing — Camp Two: Present Simple (A2) | Forbes English
description: Before now, before any of this climb, there's the mountain itself. Present simple is the solid ground everything else stands on: facts, habits, things…

hero.lede: Before now, before any of this climb, there's the mountain itself. Present simple is the solid ground everything else stands on: facts, habits, things that don't move.

img.alt: A mountain divided into six horizontal bands from peak to base, labelled never, rarely, sometimes, often, usually and always, showing frequency from rare at the summit to constant at the base

cards.head: General facts and truths
cards.body: Things that are always true, no matter when you check.

cards.head: Permanent states
cards.body: Not expected to change any time soon.

cards.head: Habits and routines
cards.body: Repeated actions, usually with a frequency word.

cards.head: Timetables and schedules
cards.body: Fixed, official times — even for a future event.

cards.head: State verbs
cards.body: Thoughts, feelings, senses and possession rarely take continuous.

cards.head: Instructions and directions
cards.body: Step-by-step sequences, like a recipe or a route.
cards.ex: "First you crack two eggs, then you whisk them."

cards.head: Affirmative
cards.body: subject + verb (+s / -es for he / she / it)

cards.head: Negative
cards.body: subject + do / does + not + base verb

cards.head: Wh- questions
cards.body: question word + do / does + subject + base verb?

charts.head: Conjugation chart
charts.note: Every person, every form — using the verb "to work" as the model.

signals.head: Time expressions
items: once a week / twice a month

examples: I sometimes take the bus to work.
She is sometimes at home by six.
freq.rule: Before a main verb: “I often go.”  ·  After be: “She is often late.”

sections.label: Printed on the wall
sections.title: The future that is already on a timetable

cards.head: Timetables and programmes
cards.body: Trains, flights, films, lessons — anything with a published time.
cards.ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."

cards.head: Somebody else set the time
cards.body: You did not decide it and you cannot move it. That is the test.

cards.head: Not your own plans
cards.body: A personal arrangement takes the present continuous instead.
cards.ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓

diagram.intro: The bedrock reaches further than it looks. When a time has been published by somebody else — a railway, a cinema, a school — English treats it as a fact rather than a plan, and a fact takes the present simple even when it happens next week. The block stands in future time, but it is the same solid ground.

quiz.hint: This is always true, everywhere — and it's third person singular (it).
quiz.explain: A permanent, universal fact takes present simple, and "water" (it) needs the -s ending: boils. "Boil" drops the agreement, and "is boils"/"am boil" wrongly mix an auxiliary with an -s form.

quiz.hint: This is her job, not a temporary arrangement — and she's third person singular.
quiz.explain: A permanent state like a job or profession takes present simple, and "my sister" (she) needs the -s ending: works. Dropping the -s, or mixing in an auxiliary like is/are, is a common agreement error.

quiz.hint: A repeated routine, marked by a frequency phrase.
quiz.explain: Every Sunday signals a routine, so present simple is correct: visit.
Fixed timetables use present simple even for a future event: leaves.

quiz.prompt: I _____ this instruction, can you explain it again? (not / understand)
quiz.hint: Understanding is a state, not an action.
quiz.explain: Understand is a state verb, so it stays in present simple even here: don't understand.

quiz.hint: Possession is a state, not something happening.
quiz.explain: Belong is a state verb and doesn't take continuous form: belongs.

quiz.prompt: First you _____ two eggs into a bowl, then you whisk them. (crack)
quiz.hint: This is a step in a set of instructions.
quiz.explain: Step-by-step instructions, like a recipe, use present simple: crack.

quiz.hint: Watch where never sits in the sentence.
quiz.explain: The frequency adverb never sits before the verb and needs no extra negative: never eats.

quiz.prompt: She _____ coffee — she says it keeps her awake. (not / drink)
quiz.hint: Negative form: does + not + base verb for he/she/it.
quiz.explain: The negative present simple for he/she/it is does + not + base verb: doesn't drink.

quiz.prompt: They _____ meat, they're both vegetarian. (not / eat)
quiz.hint: Negative form with a plural subject.
quiz.explain: With they, the negative present simple is do + not + base verb: don't eat.

quiz.hint: Yes/No question form: Do/Does + subject + base verb?
quiz.explain: Yes/No questions with he/she/it use Does + subject + base verb: Does he speak?

quiz.prompt: Where _____ you _____? I never see you at your desk. (work)
quiz.hint: Wh- question form: question word + do/does + subject + base verb?
quiz.explain: Wh- questions follow: question word + do + subject + base verb: Where do you work?

quiz.prompt: The sun _____ in the east every morning. (rise)
quiz.hint: Third person singular (it) — watch the agreement.
quiz.explain: "The sun" is third person singular (it), so the verb takes -s: rises. "Is rises" and "am rise" wrongly bolt an auxiliary onto the wrong form.
"They" is plural, so the base form with no -s is correct: speak. "Speaks" wrongly adds the third-person-singular ending to a plural subject.

en.heroP: Before now, before any of this climb, there's the mountain itself. Present simple is the solid ground everything else stands on: facts, habits, things that don't move.
en.msgStrong: Steady footing. A couple of loose stones to check before camp three.
en.msgOk: Good first attempt. Worth another pass before moving on.
en.schedTitle: The future that is already on a timetable
en.schedIntro: The bedrock reaches further than it looks. When a time has been published by somebody else — a railway, a cinema, a school — English treats it as a fact rather than a plan, and a fact takes the present simple even when it happens next week. The block stands in future time, but it is the same solid ground.
en.sch1p: Trains, flights, films, lessons — anything with a published time.
en.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
en.sch2p: You did not decide it and you cannot move it. That is the test.
en.sch3p: A personal arrangement takes the present continuous instead.

de.heroP: Vor dem Jetzt, vor diesem ganzen Aufstieg, gibt es den Berg selbst. Present Simple ist der feste Grund, auf dem alles andere steht: Fakten, Gewohnheiten, Dinge, die sich nicht bewegen.
de.msgStrong: Sicherer Stand. Ein paar lose Steine vor Camp drei noch prüfen.
de.msgOk: Guter erster Versuch. Ein weiterer Durchgang lohnt sich, bevor es weitergeht.
de.schedTitle: Die Zukunft, die schon im Fahrplan steht
de.schedIntro: Der Grundfels reicht weiter, als er aussieht. Wenn eine Zeit von jemand anderem veröffentlicht wurde — von einer Bahn, einem Kino, einer Schule —, behandelt das Englische sie als Tatsache und nicht als Plan, und eine Tatsache steht im Present Simple, auch wenn sie nächste Woche eintritt. Der Block steht in der Zukunft, ist aber derselbe feste Boden.
de.sch1p: Züge, Flüge, Filme, Unterricht — alles mit veröffentlichter Uhrzeit.
de.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
de.sch2h: Die Zeit hat jemand anderes gesetzt
de.sch2p: Du hast sie nicht bestimmt und kannst sie nicht verschieben. Das ist der Test.
de.sch3p: Eine persönliche Verabredung steht im Present Continuous.
de.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓

it.heroP: Prima di adesso, prima di questa scalata, c'è la montagna stessa. Il presente semplice è il terreno solido su cui tutto il resto si regge: fatti, abitudini, cose che non si muovono.
it.msgStrong: Buon appoggio. Qualche sasso instabile da controllare prima del campo tre.
it.msgOk: Buon primo tentativo. Vale la pena riprovare prima di proseguire.
it.schedTitle: Il futuro che è già sull’orario
it.schedIntro: La roccia madre arriva più lontano di quanto sembri. Quando un orario è stato pubblicato da qualcun altro — una ferrovia, un cinema, una scuola — l’inglese lo tratta come un fatto e non come un piano, e un fatto vuole il present simple anche se accade la settimana prossima. Il blocco sta nel futuro, ma è lo stesso terreno solido.
it.sch1p: Treni, voli, film, lezioni — tutto ciò che ha un orario pubblicato.
it.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
it.sch2p: Non l’hai scelto tu e non puoi spostarlo. È questa la prova.
it.sch3p: Un impegno personale vuole il present continuous.
it.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓
it.dgSub: un orario stampato, non un piano

es.heroP: Antes del ahora, antes de toda esta ascensión, está la propia montaña. El presente simple es el terreno sólido sobre el que se apoya todo lo demás: hechos, hábitos, cosas que no cambian.
es.msgPerfect: Terreno sólido. Lecho de roca asegurado.
es.msgStrong: Buen apoyo. Un par de piedras sueltas que revisar antes del campamento tres.
es.msgOk: Buen primer intento. Vale la pena otro intento antes de seguir.
es.schedTitle: El futuro que ya está en el horario
es.schedIntro: La roca madre llega más lejos de lo que parece. Cuando otra persona ha publicado una hora —una compañía de trenes, un cine, una escuela—, el inglés la trata como un hecho y no como un plan, y un hecho lleva presente simple aunque ocurra la semana que viene. El bloque está en el futuro, pero es el mismo suelo firme.
es.sch1p: Trenes, vuelos, películas, clases: todo lo que tiene hora publicada.
es.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
es.sch2p: No la decidiste tú y no puedes moverla. Esa es la prueba.
es.sch3p: Una cita personal lleva presente continuo.
es.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓
es.dgSub: una hora impresa, no un plan

pl.heroP: Przed teraźniejszością, przed całą tą wspinaczką, jest sama góra. Present Simple to solidny grunt, na którym stoi wszystko inne: fakty, nawyki, rzeczy, które się nie zmieniają.
pl.msgStrong: Pewny krok. Kilka luźnych kamieni do sprawdzenia przed obozem trzecim.
pl.msgOk: Dobra pierwsza próba. Warto spróbować jeszcze raz przed dalszą wspinaczką.
pl.schedTitle: Przyszłość, która jest już w rozkładzie
pl.schedIntro: Skała macierzysta sięga dalej, niż się wydaje. Gdy godzinę ogłosił ktoś inny — kolej, kino, szkoła — angielski traktuje ją jak fakt, a nie plan, a fakt wymaga present simple, nawet jeśli wydarzy się w przyszłym tygodniu. Blok stoi w przyszłości, ale to ten sam twardy grunt.
pl.sch1p: Pociągi, loty, filmy, lekcje — wszystko z ogłoszoną godziną.
pl.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
pl.sch2p: Nie ty o niej zdecydowałeś i nie możesz jej przesunąć. To jest test.
pl.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓

zh.eyebrow: 第二营地 · 一般现在时
zh.heroP: 在当下之前，在这次攀登之前，山本身就在那里。一般现在时是一切的坚实基础：事实、习惯，那些不会改变的事情。
zh.chartNote: 以动词 “to work” 为例，列出每个人称、每种形式。
zh.msgStrong: 站得稳。第三营地前还有几块松动的石头需要检查。
zh.msgOk: 不错的初次尝试。继续前进前值得再试一次。
zh.schedTitle: 已经写进时刻表的未来
zh.schedIntro: 基岩延伸得比看上去更远。当时间是别人公布的——铁路、影院、学校——英语把它当作事实而不是计划，而事实要用一般现在时，哪怕事情下周才发生。方块站在未来，但仍是同一块坚实的地面。
zh.sch1p: 火车、航班、电影、课程——凡是有公布时间的。
zh.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
zh.sch2p: 不是你决定的，你也挪不动。这就是判断标准。
zh.sch3p: 个人约定要用现在进行时。
zh.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓

fr.heroP: Avant le moment présent, avant toute cette ascension, il y a la montagne elle-même. Le présent simple est le sol solide sur lequel tout le reste repose : des faits, des habitudes, des choses qui ne bougent pas.
fr.signal1h: Fréquence, du plus haut au plus bas
fr.msgStrong: Bon appui. Quelques pierres branlantes à vérifier avant le camp trois.
fr.msgOk: Bon premier essai. Une nouvelle tentative vaut le coup avant de continuer.
fr.schedTitle: Le futur qui figure déjà à l'horaire
fr.schedIntro: Le socle va plus loin qu'il n'y paraît. Quand une heure a été publiée par quelqu'un d'autre — une compagnie ferroviaire, un cinéma, une école — l'anglais y voit un fait et non un projet, et un fait prend le présent simple, même s'il a lieu la semaine prochaine. Le bloc se tient dans le futur, mais c'est le même sol solide.
fr.sch1p: Trains, vols, films, cours — tout ce qui a une heure publiée.
fr.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
fr.sch2p: Vous ne l'avez pas décidée et vous ne pouvez pas la déplacer. C'est le test.
fr.sch3p: Un arrangement personnel prend le présent continu.
fr.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓
fr.dgSub: une heure imprimée, pas un projet

ru.heroP: До настоящего момента, до всего этого восхождения, есть сама гора. Настоящее простое время — это твёрдая почва, на которой держится всё остальное: факты, привычки, вещи, которые не меняются.
ru.chartNote: Каждое лицо, каждая форма — на примере глагола «to work».
ru.msgStrong: Уверенный шаг. Пара шатких камней требует проверки перед третьим лагерем.
ru.msgOk: Хорошая первая попытка. Стоит попробовать ещё раз перед тем, как двигаться дальше.
ru.schedIntro: Основание тянется дальше, чем кажется. Если время объявил кто-то другой — железная дорога, кинотеатр, школа — английский считает это фактом, а не планом, а факт требует present simple, даже если событие будет на следующей неделе. Блок стоит в будущем, но это та же твёрдая порода.
ru.sch1p: Поезда, рейсы, фильмы, уроки — всё, у чего есть объявленное время.
ru.sch1ex: "The train leaves at 6:40." · "The film starts at eight."
ru.sch2p: Ты его не выбирал и не можешь сдвинуть. Это и есть проверка.
ru.sch3ex: "I meet Ana tomorrow." ✗  "I'm meeting Ana tomorrow." ✓
